intro: Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and the trusted second-in-command of SI:7, stationed inside their headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town. He serves Spymaster Mathias Shaw faithfully, directing new rogue recruits and handling covert operations where typical Alliance agents cannot tread.

p: Renzik keeps the story of his past to himself. What Stormwind knows is that this goblin found his way into SI:7 and now stands as Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second in command. He has little taste for company, but the pay is good, and he values the respect his position brings; he counts himself one of the few goblins who can honestly say they are respected rather than simply feared.

Now based inside the secretive SI:7 fortress in Old Town, Renzik serves as Mathias Shaw's second-in-command. Because most intelligence agents are humans, dwarves, or gnomes who immediately stand out in Kalimdor, Renzik's goblin heritage makes him an indispensable asset for infiltrating Orgrimmar and other Horde-held territories. Rogue mentors across the Alliance—from the Hidden Circle in Ironforge to shadow operatives in Darnassus—send their most promising agents to Renzik. Rather than sending them straight to slaughter, Renzik forwards them to field instructors like Lucius in Redridge to hone their survival craft.
